name: Tainan Spinning Co., Ltd.
summary: Tainan Spinning Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of various textile products and synthetic fiber materials in Taiwan, Mainland China, Hong Kong, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers yarns, polyester fiber, polyester filament yarn, draw textured yarn, polyester chips, fiber/filament DM, and yarns DM. It is also involved in the land development; investment business; department stores operation; public housing building; commercial property sale and rental; international trade; and textile dyeing and finishing businesses. Tainan Spinning Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
